capabilities: apply colored highlights to selected text via a context menu
add annotations with notes and tags to highlights
customize highlighter colors in the settings tab
open the highlighter menu via commands and per-color hotkeys
browse highlights, annotations, and tags in a sidebar panel
extras: The README warns that the plugin does not work with the cMenu plugin. It documents the changes made over the original Highlightr plugin: a color submenu, an annotation menu, context-dependent menu items, and a sidebar panel.
intentEvidence: This plugin is based on Chetachi's original Highlightr plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in menu for applying, changing, and managing color-coded highlights and annotations on selected text.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on Chetachi's original Highlightr plugin.

summary: Highlighting menu that wraps selected text in colored HTML mark tags, adds annotations with tags, and offers customizable highlight colors.
